about-us.calm: a plain honed travertine wall in soft sunlight
about-us.still: Inside the boutique before opening: three members of the store team in oatmeal linen shirts and aprons stand together talking beside the curved copper and travertine counter at mid-distance, faces turned slightly away; bronze rails of linen clothes and two olive trees around them.

contact-us.calm: a plain honed travertine wall in soft sunlight
contact-us.still: A quiet corner of the boutique's back office: a round oak table with two linen-upholstered chairs, two ceramic coffee cups and a closed notebook on it, an olive tree beside, a bronze rail of linen clothes softly out of focus behind. Nobody there.

partners.calm: a plain honed travertine wall in soft sunlight
partners.still: The boutique's back-office studio: a long oak worktable with fabric swatches in linen and wool, a closed laptop, a tape measure and a small stack of kraft boxes; a bronze rail with sample garments behind. Nobody there.

security.calm: a plain honed travertine wall in soft sunlight
security.still: The boutique's stockroom entrance: a solid brushed steel door with a small keypad lock set into a travertine wall, an oak bench beside it, an olive tree in a stone pot, warm light. Nobody there.

infrastructure.calm: a plain warm-white painted wall in soft sunlight
infrastructure.still: The boutique's back room: a slim brushed steel server cabinet with a glass door, small green status lights glowing on the equipment inside, neat cables, standing on a terrazzo floor beside oak shelving of kraft boxes. Nobody there.

office.calm: a plain honed travertine wall in soft sunlight
office.still: The boutique's back office: an oak desk with a neat stack of printed paper documents whose lines are blurred and unreadable, a fountain pen, a ceramic cup, an olive tree beside, soft sunlight. Nobody there.
